note: 8eiek8's CONFIGURATION ON THE FULL TRAINING FOLD, 15 epochs. ONE VARIABLE: 30 structures -> 487. WHAT TRAINS: 2 tensors / 10,240 parameters, linear_no_bias_d (256x39) + linear_no_bias_d_wo_onehot (256x1), applied at ALL FOUR pairformer blocks through --pose-perblock-share, which re-applies block 0's OWN PRETRAINED pair verbatim and adds ZERO new parameters -- the literal tying of one matrix pair across four depths. No orientation, no L2-SP, no ranking term, PAE only. WHY PAE: order_accuracy.py measures ordering by SIGN alone, so it cannot be faked by shrinking margins, and on held-out val10 against shipped 0.5765 correct / 0.7469 DockQ-weighted cross-seed, 8eiek8 (PAE, pose-share) runs 0.5867/0.7485 at epoch 1 to 0.6075/0.7665 at epoch 48 -- ABOVE shipped throughout -- while 4y3ve6 (ranking, same config) never beats shipped and x5frz6 (within-seed ranking) ends BELOW shipped on all four figures. The ranking arms were compressing spread rather than learning: x5frz6 drove within-seed std 0.00593 -> 0.00147 and the top1-top2 gap 0.00205 -> 0.00015 while its loss fell, which is margin collapse. PAE INFLATES spread (0.00591 -> 0.01030) and orders better. WHY DATA AND NOT CAPACITY: 8eiek8's held-out PAE fell -0.00712/epoch for ten epochs, then 13x slower at -0.00053, then turned POSITIVE after epoch 30 at +0.00380, while training PAE kept falling 2.633 -> 2.326 for a final train-val gap of 0.479 and widening -- overfitting at 10,240 parameters on 30 structures, and the reason DockQ peaked at epoch 10 and decayed after 28. More parameters would overfit sooner. PREDICTION: at 16x the data with the same capacity the epoch-10 ceiling largely lifts. FALSIFIER: held-out PAE flattening at the same rate on 487 structures, which would say the tied injection has learned all it can express and data was never the limit. CRITERION: selected DockQ and fraction above 0.23 over the 92 valfull interfaces against shipped DERIVED FROM THIS RUN'S OWN SHARDS; held-out PAE is the secondary read and the quantity the prediction is about. VAL10 AND VALFULL ARE NOT COMPARABLE -- no number from any overfit30 arm transfers, and shipped 0.2909 / 0.5556 are val10 figures that do NOT apply here. CONTROLS: 8eiek8 (this arm on 30 structures, 50 epochs) and zg5fnw (full fold, per-block COPIES with orientation and an anchor, ranking loss). TEN-EPOCH MINIMUM before any trend claim.
